domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert number forms
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers or integers (and, when needed, pre-simplify a given fraction) into an equivalent fraction form suitable for subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: A step converts a mixed number a b/c into an improper fraction (ac+b)/c
A step rewrites an integer as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5)
A step simplifies a given fraction representation as part of preparing it for subtraction (e.g., 34/10 → 17/5 before subtracting)
exclusion_criteria: A step’s main purpose is to find an LCM/common denominator across two different denominators (tag S02 instead)
A step performs the subtraction once forms/denominators are aligned (tag S03 instead)
A step reduces or converts the final computed result to simplest/accepted form (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that shared denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM/common denominator for two denominators
A step scales numerators/denominators to express two fractions over the same denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the step proceeds directly to subtraction (tag S03 instead)
A step only converts mixed numbers/integers to fractions without addressing differing denominators (tag S01 instead)
A step only reduces/simplifies the final result (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are aligned (same denominator or separated whole and fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a shared denominator (a/b − c/b)
A step subtracts mixed numbers by subtracting whole parts and fractional parts (and combining the result)
A step completes the arithmetic difference after prior conversion/common-denominator work
exclusion_criteria: A step’s main purpose is to create equivalent forms (tag S01 or S02 instead)
A step’s main purpose is to reduce/format the final answer (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Express the computed difference in simplest accepted form by reducing fractions and/or rewriting an improper fraction as a mixed number or integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step states the result is already in lowest terms
A step rewrites an improper fraction as a mixed number or identifies an integer result
exclusion_criteria: A step only performs subtraction without any simplification/final-form action
A step only finds a common denominator (tag S02 instead) or converts number forms to enable subtraction (tag S01 instead)
